title: Claude Vision Viral Pre-Selection Scorer
goal: Replace weak metadata proxies (duration/resolution for Pexels, engagement for Pixabay) with Claude Vision scoring on thumbnails before any clip is selected. Based on viral_detection_upgrade_report.md — implements Stage 3 (Content Understanding) using Claude Haiku as the multimodal scorer.
source: viral_detection_upgrade_report.md — Method 9 (Multimodal LLM Frame Analysis), adapted to use Claude Vision instead of Gemini/GPT-4o for zero-infrastructure integration.

tasks.title: viral-scorer.ts
tasks.description: Claude Haiku Vision scorer. Accepts thumbnail URL + metadata hint. Returns ViralScore: clip_worthy, hook_score (0-10), emotional_trigger, motion_quality, topic_category, reasoning, composite_score (0-100). Composite = hook(40%) + emotion(35%) + motion(25%). Never throws — returns FALLBACK_SCORE on failure. Skips when SKIP_VISION_SCORING=1.

tasks.title: pexels-client.ts update
tasks.description: Add image field to PexelsVideo interface. After API fetch, score all thumbnails in parallel via Promise.allSettled. Update item.score with composite_score. Filter out clip_worthy=false items. Remove old deriveScore() proxy.

tasks.title: pixabay-client.ts update
tasks.description: Add picture_id field to PixabayHit. Construct thumbnail URL as https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/{picture_id}_640x360.jpg. Score all thumbnails in parallel. Update score with composite_score * engagement_boost multiplier (preserves Pixabay's existing engagement signal). Filter out clip_worthy=false items.
